To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
strategic consensus is not a unitary construct, and the quality of internal communication is associated with strategic consensus.

the relationship between internal organizational communication and between group (i.e., top management team and employees) strategic consensus varies according to content and direction of strategic consensus.

the relationship between internal organizational communication and between group consensus is positive and that the quality of organizational information is the most important predictor of strategic consensus.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question whether employees see eye to eye on strategic priorities.
the relationship between internal corporate communication and strategic consensus.

the question of whether employees in different hierarchical levels see eye to eye with respect to strategic priorities and the relationship between internal corporate communication and strategic consensus.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a high level of internal communication is associated with higher levels and more accurate perceptions of strategic consensus between employee groups.

a high quality internal communication climate and an organizational culture that is characterized by a high level of integration and a high degree of vertical communication are important antecedents for strategic consensus between hierarhically distant employee groups.
the relationship between strategic consensus and internal communication depends on the content domain under consideration and the direction of between-group disconsensus.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the perceived quality and quantity of organizational information and the perceived integration and quality of vertical communication are positively associated with the degree of between group strategic consensus.
the perceived quality and the frequency of communication are important antecedents of between group strategic consensus.
the quality of internal communication is an important antecedent of between group strategic consensus, which is a key factor for effective strategy execution.
The main takeaway from our work is that
communication is a key antecedent of strategic consensus between groups.
internal communication is associated with strategic consensus, and thus, internal communication should be considered a strategic management issue.
the quality and quantity of internal communication is associated with the degree of between group strategic consensus and thus, may be a key factor in strategy execution.
